operational_definitions.misled_on_noisy_episode: adaptive decision was wrong while at least one matched simple control was correct; this is an episode-level diagnostic, not a causal attribution to a specific observation
operational_definitions.spends_after_sufficiency: the adaptive policy acquired evidence when the exact public-state oracle selected STOP
operational_definitions.stops_incorrectly: the exact public-state oracle preferred an acquisition when the adaptive policy selected STOP

population_interpretation: Frozen deterministic benchmark population; differences are population quantities. Bootstrap intervals are paired descriptive sensitivity intervals, not significance claims.
